Admin access

Enter the Private Admin Password to open the private administration area. This is separate from every Owner login password.

Generate Owner credentials

First enter the Business Name and Owner Name. Then generate the three login values. You will see the exact 5 values before creating the Owner.

What you will give the Owner
Station ID + Login Code + Password. These exact values will be used for the Owner login.
